article.story: JOHNSON CITY, Tenn. -- — Anthony Ruffolo had 27 points in Charleston Southern’s 76-67 victory against East Tennessee State on Friday. Ruffolo also added five rebounds for the Buccaneers (3-5). Alex Harper added 18 points, five rebounds and five assists. Lase Olalere shot 5 of 6 from the field and 1 for 4 from the free-throw line to finish with 11 points, while adding three blocks. Kendall Campbell led the Buccaneers (3-4) in scoring, finishing with 14 points and nine rebounds. Trevor Henning added 14 points and two steals for East Tennessee State. Tyran Mason finished with 12 points and three steals. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
